name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU kitchen installation in the East Bay?
description: Choose an East Bay contractor with ADU experience, local permitting knowledge, proper licensing, insurance, and good references.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my ADU kitchen installation in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for your ADU kitchen installation in the East Bay, look for one with specific experience in ADU construction and local permitting processes within areas like Oakland, Berkeley, or Fremont. Verify their licensing, insurance, and ask for references from previous ADU projects. It's important to select a contractor who demonstrates clear communication, provides detailed proposals, and understands the unique challenges and opportunities of building accessory dwelling units. Hometelligent Inc. has a proven track record in ADU projects across the East Bay.
